central_correction: A fixed-nucleus Rayleigh Kramers-Heisenberg-Waller amplitude cannot be made genuinely two-frequency merely by inserting omega_in != omega_out. For Rayleigh A=B, fixed-nucleus energy conservation requires omega_in=omega_out. Recoil requires center-of-mass momentum states in the initial, intermediate, and final atomic energies.

COM_resolved_denominators.energy_conservation: E_A + P_i^2/(2M) + hbar omega_i = E_B + P_f^2/(2M) + hbar omega_o

initial_atom_rest_denominators.absorption_first: D_I^- = Delta_I - hbar omega_i + hbar^2 omega_i^2/(2 M c^2)
initial_atom_rest_denominators.emission_first: D_I^+ = Delta_I + hbar omega_o + hbar^2 omega_o^2/(2 M c^2)
initial_atom_rest_denominators.moving_atom_absorption: D_I^- = Delta_I - hbar omega_i + hbar omega_i (v.n_i)/c + hbar^2 omega_i^2/(2 M c^2)
initial_atom_rest_denominators.moving_atom_emission_first: D_I^+ = Delta_I + hbar omega_o - hbar omega_o (v.n_o)/c + hbar^2 omega_o^2/(2 M c^2)

width_firewall: The exact proof uses the full resolvent or zero-width denominators.
Do not insert a phenomenological -i Gamma/2 only in one forward denominator and then claim exact amplitude reciprocity.
If widths/self-energies are used, derive both forward and reverse kernels from the same causal self-energy prescription and verify detailed balance at the rate-kernel level.
